inputs.text: I just heard from Hyderabad that KT Rama Rao, the BRS Working President, is accusing the Congress government on Sunday, March 29, of corruption and failing to act against illegal mining. He alleges that Raghava Constructions, a company belonging to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy, is involved in illegal mining. But this is clearly just another example of coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions. The failure to stop the illegal mining is no accident—it's intentional to benefit their connected interests who are extracting and profiting from it, while the accusations keep the rest of us distracted and thinking there's real opposition going on.
